Lorgus Jett is a human among the Twilight's Hammer in Blackfathom Deeps. While many cultists there are orcs or tauren, Jett ranges from the upper Moonshrine Ruins to the tunnels beyond Gelihast, the murloc defiler. He coordinates the cult's rituals and violent ambitions in the ancient night elf ruins.
